source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Foundations were checked against Bolosky/Scott, Patterson/Hennessy, Herlihy/Shavit, and Drepper. Current layout and tooling claims were checked against the C++ hardware-interference draft, current Linux kernel false-sharing guidance, Intel Optimization Manual v050 and VTune/oneTBB documentation, and current Arm SPE guidance. Tool events are labeled target-specific.

evidence: Definitions and Notation defines B, line(a), n, s, T_p, and S_p before mathematical use.
Candidate predicates consistently require distinct logical data, same block, and at least one writer.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Address, floor, offset, peer-count, and speedup notation were reviewed; candidate placement is never mislabeled as measured cost.

evidence: artifacts/snippets/CONPAR-029/report.json records eight packed counters in one line, 56 directed peers, eight padded lines, zero padded peers, and 8x footprint.
Exercise 2 independently recomputes addresses 0..56, packed line zero, padded indices 0..7, and 8*7=56.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All layout arithmetic, directed relationship counts, and footprint ratios match exact executable output.

evidence: For n packed writers each sharing with n-1 others, directed relationships re-derive as n(n-1).
The address predicate line(a)=floor(a/B) correctly derives same-block membership under the stated simplified fixed-granule model.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Symbolic results are scoped to aligned fixed-stride assumptions and explicitly do not count real invalidations.

evidence: Reviewed read/read, write/read, write/write, true sharing, false sharing, cold adjacency, unaligned base, straddling elements, allocator neighbors, and redundant writes.
Reviewed SMT, sockets, NUMA, migration, varying granules, ABI/FFI, working-set/TLB cost, bottleneck migration, security, and real-time transfer.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary review covers functional, layout, access-pattern, topology, portability, measurement, and deployment failure.

evidence: The diagnosis invariant requires race freedom plus distinct data/same block/at-least-one-writer plus material measured traffic.
Mitigation preserves correctness and ABI while separately accounting for footprint, locality, NUMA, scheduling, and authoritative state.
invariant_checking.notes: No padding or sharding recommendation is permitted to weaken source correctness, ownership, accounting, or interface stability.

evidence: The mechanism proof distinguishes source objects from coherence ownership blocks and explains why writer traffic can move the shared block.
The causal workflow requires a one-variable layout/ownership intervention followed by both traffic and application-outcome change.
proof_review.notes: The chapter proves only candidate relationships arithmetically; material false sharing remains an empirical causal claim.

evidence: The simplified coherence and address models are explicitly labeled diagnostic cartoons rather than architectural theorems.
Executable limitations enumerate alignment, allocator, cache-state, invalidation, NUMA, compiler, and speedup omissions.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Mechanism explanation, layout derivation, counter evidence, and performance conclusions are kept at their proper evidence levels.

evidence: python3 tools/verify_snippets.py CONPAR-029 passed the one deterministic layout snippet with exact stdout and empty stderr.
Production claims require controlled repeated trials, line/offset/PC attribution, target event caveats, and before/after traffic plus outcomes.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No speedup, cache-line size, HITM interpretation, or target behavior is inferred from the Python arithmetic.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed distinctions among race, coherence, true sharing, false sharing, capacity miss, lock contention, atomic ordering, locality, and scalability. Access-pattern and topology premises are consistently stated.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed controlled experiments, perf c2c/pahole/VTune/SPE attribution, base alignment and stride, allocators, padding, sharding, batching, partitioning, lock placement, NUMA, ABI, workload correctness, rollout evidence, and bottleneck migration.

pedagogical_review.notes: The review sheet supports rapid retrieval; exposition moves from race freedom through mechanism, diagnosis, mitigation, and measurement; ten examples are distinct; five exercises progress from definitions to safety-critical transfer with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring and verification evidence only; no external academic, architecture-vendor, kernel, performance, security, financial, real-time, regulatory, or functional-safety review is claimed. The arithmetic model does not measure coherence states, invalidations, topology, target cache granules, application speedup, or deployment fitness.
